name: Times cryptic crossword, Crossword book 1 No 1

clue.text: High-flier ruined by exposure in Sun
Nonconformist churchman’s back I protected from rain
Opposition is hesitant to reform
Arranger selecting odd pieces for composer
Frosty spell in unfriendly game
Characteristic tone in old instrument cut short
Charge for conversion as gas is offered, initially
Call artist a venomous creature
Strange sort of small house? Indeed, it was
Absence of authorisation for retreat
Was mistress under stress? Sounds like it
Specify drink — same again?
Architect leaves sewer after fall
Like a resistance force made up without ringleader
American statesman noted for his Canterbury relation
For example, miss a run
Censor accepts new section in poem
They make up shower curtains artist at home put up
“A man” finally solved her cryptic puzzle
Maiden is under arrest? Just the opposite — that’s an error
One making late appearance (it’s in a TV broadcast)
Raise millions to modernise the forces
Singer, no pro, gets lot wrong
One sort of bird — and another right outside
Leaves without the slightest difficulty
Small meal? It’s hard to say
Fine Italian instruments you love in Rome
Involved in begging, a minor?
One in exaltation turned up round a village

NOTES ACROSS ICARUS The whole clue is a cryptic definition, and has nothing to do with a tabloid scandal about a successful person. Icarus and his father Daedalus made wings to escape from Crete but Icarus flew too high and the wax securing his wings melted in the sun’s rays, so he fell to his death.
